findings.rationale: Confirmed by three seats: a test-only p7 carve-out and aborted-directory recreation leaked into production. Remove the carve-out, require every predecessor finalized, never recreate a generation directory (an aborted retry gets a new generation number or the retry is recorded without deleting evidence).

Confirmed: seat_artifact_sha256 may be empty and the minimum reviewed-seat count is receipt-supplied. Require exact seat-to-hash coverage for every seat in the chain entry, derive reviewed status from validated seat artifacts, and take the minimum from configuration (default: all seats).
Confirmed: candidate_blocker must be a mandatory boolean on every canonical plan finding and its disposition class must match.
Confirmed: open_findings must be the canonical array and deep-equal the re-derived entries; numeric or absent forms are rejected.
Confirmed (was a BACKLOG row): canonicalise runner aliases (codex-cli≡codex) before every collision, exclusion and tuple-key comparison in the resolver and the topology script.
